description.content:
Fetch the model corresponding to the specified model ID.

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COVEO_ML","targetDomain":"MODELS","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

variable.description:
(Required) The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

(Required) The unique identifier of the target machine learning model.
**Example:** `My_Model_ID`
